resources.string: Please attach or swipe your YubiKey now.
Your device supports neither USB host mode nor NFC. YubiKeys can not be used.
Please press the button on your YubiKey.
Access to your YubiKey was denied. Please unplug it and attach it again.
Your YubiKey did not respond. Is the selected slot set up for HMAC-SHA1 challenge-response? Please try the other slot.
OTP is disabled on your YubiKey, so it can not be used over USB. Please enable it using YubiKey Manager or use NFC.
The connection to your YubiKey was lost. Please hold it against your device until this dialog closes.
Your YubiKey rejected the request. Over NFC, OTP must be enabled and the slot must not require touching the button.
Something went wrong. Please try again.
An error has occurred. Please unplug your YubiKey.
An invalid challenge was passed. If this problem persists, please contact the vendor of the app you are trying to use ykDroid with.
